name: Ordinary game progression
test:
game = Game()
for player in ['A', 'A', 'B', 'B', 'A']:
    game.record_point(player)
assert game.get_score() == '40-30'

name: Deuce and advantage
input: A, A, A, B, B, B, A, B, B
test:
game = Game()
for player in ['A', 'A', 'A', 'B', 'B', 'B', 'A', 'B', 'B']:
    game.record_point(player)
assert game.get_score() == 'advantage B'
